name: Stitchbay
summary: A clothing and shoe shop with a size advisor and its own admin dashboard behind a Website switch
about: A friendly clothing and shoe store and the dashboard that runs it, in one file. A pill switch flips the whole app between Website and Dashboard with a card-flip. The shop has swinging hangers in the hero, filters and sort, colour and size pickers, a size advisor with a gauge and a match score, a bag in PKR with promo codes and a checkout. The dashboard shows revenue, orders, stock and customers, and new storefront orders appear there straight away. Good for a small fashion label, a shoe shop or anyone who wants a shop and its admin in one demo.
how: Clothes slide in on a rail and swing on their hangers while the headline pops in letter by letter.
Use the Website and Dashboard switch at the top to flip between the shop and the admin; on phones a bottom tab bar follows you.
In Shop, filter by category, colour, size, price or sale, search, and change the sort.
On a product, pick a colour and size, or press Find my size: move the sliders and the gauge needle swings to your size with a match score, then Use this size.
Add to bag: a needle sews a seam across the button and the garment flies to the bag. Try HELLO10 or FREESHIP in the bag.
Checkout validates your details, then your order appears at the top of the Dashboard, where you can change its status, edit stock, add a product to the shop and browse customers.
